## CLIProxyAPI extraction: the typed config and auth-file fields

> **Last verified:** 2026-10-14 — CPA 8.0.28: 865 config nodes (575 leaves, 556
> under `api-keys`), 16 auth-file fields; 13 config rows (5 of them patterns)
> and 10 account rows by hand; the instance sample is loaded with `LoadConfig`;
> the account type's open keys refuse `ignored` and credential-shaped names.
>
> **Settled — do not relitigate.** `v8Paths` is NOT the v8 schema: its 118
> entries are only the RELOCATED leaves (every one has `old != current`, and it
> stops at a slice or map). Fields already at their v8 path (`routing.*`,
> `models.*`, `plugins.*`, `client.*`, `quota-exceeded.switch-*`) have no entry,
> and the upstream key families come from `v8KeyFamilies` plus `expandV8Groups`.
> Reflect alone, or `v8Paths` alone, gives a wrong tree (measured 2026-10-14).

The `ai.proxy.instances.<name>.settings` and `.accounts` options are generated
from `packages/cliproxyapi/extracted/x86_64-linux.json`, measured once (the
answer is the same on every host). Nothing in them is hand-typed except the rows
in `extract/annotations.json`.

### Extraction (`extract/`)

`default.nix` copies the pinned source, adds the package's `goModules` as
`vendor/`, drops two Go test files into the packages whose unexported tables
they read, and runs `go test` offline with the package's own toolchain
(`GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor GOTOOLCHAIN=local`). The same harness backs
the validator check.

- `config_test.go` (package `config`) walks `Config` by reflect, maps each
  legacy path to v8 through `v8Paths` (prefix rewrite), then `v8StructPaths`,
  then identity when the root is in `v8AllowedRoots()`. A key family becomes
  `api-keys.<family>[]` groups holding `name`, `keys` and, from the key struct,
  `base-url` plus the `sharedKeyFields` (group and key level both; CPA lets a
  key override a group value); `openai-compatibility` keeps its group struct
  with `api-key-entries` as `keys`. Neither reads `auth-index`. Every `v8Paths`
  current must come out, or the test fails.
- Node: `type` (`bool int number string duration list map object any`),
  `description` (the field's Go doc comment, by go/parser) and `template` (the
  comment config.example.yaml carries at the same v8 path; commented-out YAML
  lines are dropped). A non-struct type with its own YAML decoder is `any`. Two
  structs flattening into one mapping (`claude`, `claude.claude-code`) join
  their descriptions; two leaves on one path fail.
- Path grammar: `.` between keys, `[]` for a list element, `.<name>` for a map
  value.
- `accounts_test.go` (package `synthesizer`) follows calls from
  `synthesizeFileAuths` through the synthesizer and `sdk/cliproxy/auth`, and
  records each read of the file's metadata map: the key (a literal, a package
  const, or a `range []string{…}` value), the Go types its assertions and type
  switches name, and the spellings `CanonicalCredentialMetadataKey` folds into
  it. A read whose key it cannot resolve fails the test, except keys derived
  from `for k := range metadata` (the normalization walk). Reads the executors
  make later (`cloak_mode`, `request_retry`) are not on that path.

`facts.json` declares `config` and `accounts` as opaque `object`s: their keys
contain dots.

### Hand layer (`extract/annotations.json`, `extract/rules.nix`)

`rules.nix` reconciles each tree with `lib/extracted/reconcile.nix`; a row for a
path that no longer exists fails `cliproxyapi-extracted`, as does a
credential-shaped path without its row.

- `config`: `enum` (the values a string accepts, from the field's own prose) and
  `secret` (why the path takes `mkSecretType`). Every upstream `api-key`,
  `proxy-url` and `headers.<name>`, `requests.proxy-url`,
  `management.secret-key`, `server.github-token`, the TURN credential and
  `access.api-keys[]` are secrets. A row whose path holds `*` is passed to
  `reconcile` as a pattern (`api-keys.*[].proxy-url`), one row for a field every
  key family repeats.
- `accounts`: `type` (a Go type: `[]T`, `map[string]T`, `bool`, `float64`,
  `int`, `string`, `any`) where the reads assert none or several, `secret` for a
  field whose strings take `mkSecretType` (`proxy_url`, `headers`), and
  `ignored` for identity and tokens (`type`, `email`, `id_token`, `plan_type`).
  `secretNeeds = ["ignored"]`: a credential-shaped field passes only as ignored.

### Reader (`lib/extracted.nix`)

Reads the committed sidecar with `builtins.fromJSON` (no IFD). `settingsType`
builds a submodule per object (open to unknown keys), `listOf`/`attrsOf` for
lists and maps, `enum` and `mkSecretType` from the rows; every field is
`nullOr`, default null. `render` drops nulls and empty typed objects, writes a
`plain` secret in place and returns the `file`/`helper` ones with their JSON
paths. `accountType` maps the Go types, a `secret` field's strings to
`mkSecretType`, and is open to any other key (`freeformType`), since the
executors' reads are off the extracted path. The open keys refuse every
`ignored` row's field (`rules.nix` returns them as `accounts.ignored`, the
reason in the error) and every name `lib/runtime-values`' `classify` flags as
credential-shaped, the reconcile test's classifier: `access_token`,
`refresh_token` and `api_key` are not extracted, so a row for them would fail as
stale. `renderAccount` splits an account the way `render` splits settings.
`tree` exposes the nodes for checks.

### Checks and updates

- `cliproxyapi-extracted`: fresh extraction == committed raw, plus the rules'
  failures. Regenerate with
  `nix run .#checks.x86_64-linux.cliproxyapi-extracted.passthru.regenerate`.
- `cliproxyapi-config-validates`: renders a sample setting every typed path
  (`any` left unset; catalog sources absolute) and an instance-shaped sample
  through `settingsType` and `render`. The every-path sample gets CPA's
  `ValidateV8Config` only: its placeholder strings are no CIDR or URL, which
  `LoadConfig` checks. The instance sample is completed by `lib/config.jq`, the
  filter the ai.proxy start script runs (file secrets read with
  `mkSecretExport`, a client key, an auth dir), then gets `ValidateV8Config` and
  `LoadConfig`, the loader the service runs, on a writable copy. A config with
  an unknown `server` key fails it (checked 2026-10-14); the every-path sample
  fails `LoadConfig` on `trusted-proxies` (checked 2026-10-14).
- The update script regenerates the raw after the floor and vendor fixes
  (`mkGoUpdateExtract` `extraAfter`), so a bump lands with its new tree.
